narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Brief Over the Terrain"**

The animal is the unit of everything. The owner's question (which animal, what care, when, where) rides above every list as one floating white capsule, and everything under it is an answer to what the capsule says. Each answer, each decision, each fact is one soft white card on a mist ground: a cool green-grey drawn from the brand teal, not the cream the 1.2 audit removed. Warmth comes from the content, the animals and the people, never from a beige page.

Colour does exactly two jobs. Deep teal is the only thing you can press, and it is always a pill. Terracotta, its soft tint, sand and sky belong to animals and people: illustration tiles, monograms, the brand paw. The type is one family, Readex Pro, drawn for Latin and Arabic together, set semibold with tight tracking for display roles. Depth is one soft, ink-tinted shadow from a single light source; only things that genuinely float (the capsule, the tab bar, popovers, sheets) get the raised shadow.

**The rule that shapes everything else is honesty.** Nidz is a prototype with no backend, and the interface may not imply a capability that does not exist. Several visual choices exist only because of that: there are no trust badges, star ratings, "verified" marks, response-time chips or online dots, because `SitterProfile` carries no such field. Every claim about a sitter wears a provenance byline (`ProvenanceLabel`, `src/components/shared/trust.tsx`), a 14px Lucide icon plus a 12px muted label, and only the "declared" category may render; the others throw in development. Simulated behaviour carries a `DemoNotice` card at the same weight as the content it qualifies, never a footnote. Messages show when a note was written on this device and never "sent", "delivered", "read" or "seen".
keyCharacteristics: Mist ground, white cards (22px radius) under one soft ink-tinted shadow; never a card inside a card.
Teal `#0F766E` is the only action colour and every action is a pill.
Terracotta, sand and sky are non-interactive: animals and people only.
Readex Pro Variable for Latin and Arabic, self-hosted, semibold display with negative tracking.
The brief capsule floats above results, the sitter profile and the request review.
Lucide 2px icons first; a handful of custom icons in Lucide's grammar; flat authored animal illustrations.
Provenance bylines instead of badges; demo notices at full weight; no read receipts.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only colour that means "press this", and it is always a pill. `primary-deep` shares the hue but is never pressable.

rules.name: The Living Things Rule
rules.body: Terracotta, `brand-soft`, sand and sky carry animals and people. They never carry a state (hover, focus, selection, error) and never fill an action button. Two exceptions, both recorded in §0.1-A: the **resting** fill of an illustrated animal-category card, whose selection is carried by the 2.5px teal ring and the check badge; and sand on the pending status, always beside its clock.

rules.name: The Teal Tile Rule
rules.body: An interface icon tile (housing, rates, limits, account rows, empty states) is `primary-soft` with a teal glyph, or `secondary` with an ink glyph. Never terracotta.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: CSS `--accent` is shadcn's neutral highlight surface (aliased to `primary-soft`); the warm brand colour lives on `--brand`. Never put terracotta in `--accent`.

rules.name: The Unsent Is Uncoloured Rule
rules.body: A request in preparation never wears a status colour. Nothing has a status until a request exists.

rules.name: The Art Constants Rule
rules.body: Fur, beak and feather colours are artwork constants in `src/components/illustrations/animals.tsx`, not tokens. Where a token exists (ink, the teal collar) the artwork uses it.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Readex Pro for everything, both scripts. No display serif, no system display face, no Google Fonts request.

rules.name: The Script-Safe Rule
rules.body: No uppercase and no letter-spacing on running labels: uppercase is a no-op in Arabic and tracking breaks cursive joining. Negative tracking is a display-role property only.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Readex Pro's figures are proportional; prices and dates in lists ask for `tabular-nums` at the call site.

rules.name: The One Idea Per Card Rule
rules.body: One card holds one idea, thumb-sized. Never a card inside a card; inside a card, use a `muted` or tinted tile instead.

rules.name: The Floating Means Raised Rule
rules.body: `raised` is reserved for things that float over content. A resting card earns it only as hover feedback.

rules.name: The Forced-Colours Edge Rule
rules.body: Pills and chips carry a transparent 1px border so that forced-colours mode, which drops shadows, still draws an edge.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: Every action is a capsule, the shape of an iOS notification. One shape for everything pressable means the eye learns it once.

rules.name: The Round Tile Rule
rules.body: Icons and portraits sit in circles: 40px in list rows, 44px in option rows and the capsule, 48px in sitter cards, 64px in empty states.

dos: **Do** put every screen on the mist ground (`#EDF2F0`) and every idea in one white `xl` card with the `card` shadow.
**Do** make every action a pill, and make teal the only filled action colour on a screen.
**Do** use `surface` (white, `pill` shadow) for the second action on the ground and `outline` for a secondary action inside a white card.
**Do** mark selection with the teal ring plus a check (chips 1.5px, option rows 2px, animal cards 2.5px).
**Do** use the brief capsule above any list or decision that answers the owner's brief.
**Do** give every claim about a sitter a `ProvenanceLabel`, and every simulated step a full-weight `DemoNotice`.
**Do** keep errors, constraints, formats, privacy facts and honesty statements visible; only the *why* goes behind the "!".
**Do** isolate user text with `<bdi>` or `dir="auto"` and test every screen in Arabic.
**Do** reach for Lucide first, and draw a custom icon in its grammar only when Lucide lacks the picture.
**Do** keep artwork colours in `animals.tsx` and interface colours in tokens.
donts: **Don't** use terracotta, `brand-soft`, sand or sky for a button, a link, a hover, a focus, a selection or an interface icon tile.
**Don't** put anything pressable on the deep-teal hero field.
**Don't** nest a card inside a card, or turn a navigation row into a card of its own.
**Don't** render a badge, star rating, "verified" mark, response time, completed-stays count or online dot; there is no mechanism behind any of them.
**Don't** show "sent", "delivered", "read" or "seen" in Messages, or present an unsent request with a status colour.
**Don't** render "available" from a sitter who has not declared themselves busy.
**Don't** use uppercase or letter-spacing on running labels, or a second typeface.
**Don't** use destructive red for a declined request; it is a normal outcome.
**Don't** rely on colour alone for any state, or on a hairline as the only edge of a control.
**Don't** let an inline link stand on colour alone; underline it.
